[align=center][b][background=#FF9A4A][color=#0a0f1c] Paradise Station [/color][/background][color=#FF9A4A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835115][color=#FF9A4A]Your flight[/color][/url][color=#FF9A4A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#FF9A4A]Who flies us[/color][/url][color=#FF9A4A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#FF9A4A]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-orbital/apogee-orbital-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-orbital/apogee-orbital-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Down there, the air is sold by the hour and the rain arrives by district. Up here, the sun rises sixteen times a day and nobody owes anybody anything. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Paradise Station[/color][/url][color=white] is the only hotel in orbit: a white ring turning slowly above the Pacific, with sixty suites, one restaurant and the best view in history.[/color]

[color=white]Apogee Orbital was founded in 2071 by Commander Dana Whitlock, a retired [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay Astral[/color][/url][color=white] pilot who had seen the Earth from above for thirty years and decided to sell the view. Every guest flies on a BeDay rocket from the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] Spaceport. The view is the same for everyone. The price is not.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-orbital/apogee-orbital-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-orbital/apogee-orbital-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9A4A][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Can I see Los Vales from up there?[/b][/color][color=white] At night you can see the seven cities clearly — and the dark between them.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is the air free?[/b][/color][color=white] Air is included in every package. For many guests it is the first air of their lives that [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]Fresh Air Co[/color][/url][color=white] did not bill.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who can book?[/b][/color][color=white] Anyone with a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]Life Score[/color][/url][color=white] above 900. We have never asked anyone else to leave, because nobody else has ever arrived.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is it safe?[/b][/color][color=white] Paradise Station has had no incidents since it opened. What happened to the BeDay station in 2077 has nothing to do with us.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"From up here, nobody is in debt." — Commander Dana Whitlock[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-orbital/apogee-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835114][color=#FF9A4A]Paradise Station[/color][/url][color=#FF9A4A] | [/color][background=#FF9A4A][color=#0a0f1c] Your flight [/color][/background][color=#FF9A4A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#FF9A4A]Who flies us[/color][/url][color=#FF9A4A] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#FF9A4A]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-flight/apogee-flight-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-flight/apogee-flight-2.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-flight/apogee-flight-3.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-flight/apogee-flight-4.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9A4A][b]WHAT TO BRING[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Nothing. Clothes, food, air and gravity are provided. Implants are welcome — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] Iron Lungs make the launch easier — and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] doses are not allowed on board: in orbit, the dream is outside the window.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9A4A][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is the Spaceport safe?[/b][/color][color=white] It is fenced, watched and guarded by WM-Automa. The workers of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] who build our rockets are not allowed past the second gate.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I bring my children?[/b][/color][color=white] From age twelve, with a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]Life Score[/color][/url][color=white] of their own above 900.[/color]

[color=white][b]What if I cannot afford it?[/b][/color][color=white] Watch [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Paradise Station[/color][/url][color=white] 2. It was filmed here.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Leave everything behind. We mean everything." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2835114][color=#7FDBFF][i]Apogee Orbital[/i][/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/apogee-flight/apogee-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]
